sshOperations.description: Ordered SSH operation workflows to run. The role executes each matching tasks/<operation>.yml file in list order.

sshKeyPrefix.description: Prefix used to construct the per-host 1Password SSH Key item name.

sshLoginPrefix.description: Prefix used to construct the per-host 1Password Login item name.

vpnHostname.description: Per-host VPN name combined with vpnDomain for SSH routing.

useVpn.description: Use the VPN address for SSH routing.

vpnDomain.description: VPN domain suffix combined with the VPN hostname for SSH routing.
